settings.heading: Our Story
settings.subheading: Three generations at the same trade — genuine watches, sold and serviced properly.
settings.story:
Sethi Watch has traded as an authorised multi-brand watch retailer since 1950. What started as a single counter has grown into three boutiques across Delhi and Noida, carrying more than twenty watchmakers — from everyday names like Titan and Casio to Swiss and Japanese houses like Seiko, Citizen and Victorinox.

We are an authorised dealer for every brand we carry, and an authorised Casio Service Centre — meaning we don't just sell watches, we service them, with genuine parts and trained technicians, for customers who bought from us and customers who didn't.

Seventy-six years in, the trade hasn't changed: a genuine watch, a real warranty, and someone who picks up the phone when something needs fixing.
